text:
Sana: quick pulse — i'm starting a bring-up for ember13b-int8 on hosted. want a short econ+fidelity sanity before we open traffic. TL;DR: latency looks good, int8 cost ~40% lower, but a few longform slices show fluency/recall drift.

Mike: numbers? per-1k token econ and latency?

Jess: ran local sweep earlier today. short summary: fp16 vs int8 vs int4 (single-run, mixed prompt types):
Jess: `fp16: 120ms/req, $0.95 per 1k tokens`
Jess: `int8: 95ms/req, $0.57 per 1k tokens`
Jess: `int4 (experimental): 80ms/req, $0.42 per 1k tokens but ~5-8% quality hit on long answers`

Tom: whats “quality hit” precisely? any metric diffs?

Jess: small slice metrics — multi-turn QA and long summarization:
Jess: `ExactMatch QA: fp16 78.4 -> int8 76.9 -> int4 71.2`
Jess: `ROUGE-L (long summaries): fp16 0.62 -> int8 0.59 -> int4 0.51`
Jess: `Hallucination proxy (entailment score): fp16 0.88 -> int8 0.85 -> int4 0.78`

Sana: interesting — int8 looks fine for chat/short completions, but we should be cautious for >800 token outputs. Product teams care more about recall in our summarization flows.

Mike: recommends? canary size? gating?

Sana: propose this rollout plan:
Sana: 1) Canary 2% traffic (non-billing experiment) for short-turn features (<=300 tokens). monitor cost delta + top-k fidelity signals.
Sana: 2) Shadow traffic for long-turn routes (>=800 tokens) for 48h, compare recall/ROUGE on the golden slices.
Sana: 3) If ROUGE drop > 2.5 points or EM drop >1.5 points on any critical slice, automatic rollback to ember13b-fp16.

Tom: fallback routing suggestion — route by prompt-length + novelty score (if novelty_high -> use fp16).

Jess: adding eval hooks now. I'll push a small check that computes the 3 metrics per slice and posts to console every 15m.

Mike: unit econ note for GTN/product: if int8 is stable on short-turns, we can offer a ~35-40% price reduction surface for those endpoints. but call it out: not for retrieval/summarization.

Sana: can we get a tiny scorecard to hand to GTN: include per-slice EM/ROUGE, latency p50/p95, cost per 1k tokens, recommended route? we should keep it <=1 page.

Jess: drafting now. sample card fields: model, quant level, p50/p95, cost/1k, delta_vs_fp16(cost,EM,ROUGE), recommended_routes, canary_fraction, rollback_triggers.

Tom: add a short note on eval set composition (proportions of long vs short) — product will ask.

Sana: ops ask: create a canary that only serves workspace-beta customers first. no billing changes until we sign off.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: ember13b-int8 -> pool-03 (canary 2%). Logs: `canary_start id=cb-2026-03-21-1777779999`

Mike: perfect. Jess — ping when the Console dashboard with the slice metrics is up. i'll prepare the GTN one-pager draft.

Jess: will do — ETA 3h. collecting a few more examples where int8 diverges so product can inspect side-by-side.

Sana: follow-up action items:
Sana: - Jess: attach 10 example diffs for long-summary divergence in the ticket.
Sana: - Tom: add routing flag (novelty+length) to prod routing config.
Sana: - Mike: draft GTN one-pager with unit econ table.
Sana: - Ops: keep canary at 2% until 24h stable then bump to 5% for short-turns.

Tom: noted, i'll open the routing PR today.

deploy-bot: Canary health check (15m): p50=98ms, p95=210ms, error_rate=0.1%

Sana: thanks team. good start — let's keep the handoff tight to GTN and docs: add the scorecard to the model page in Console and flag the slices to watch. :thumbsup:

Mike: ready to sync with product at 4pm PT.

Jess: posting the mini-scorecard to the thread once ready.

Sana: if anyone sees a >3pt ROUGE regression, ping #eng-oncall immediately and i'll trigger rollback.

Tom: copying the routing PR number here when open.

Jess: posted: https://console.internal/redwood/models/ember13b-int8/mini-scorecard — includes the diffs and sample cases (private link).

Sana: closing loop: we'll reconvene after the 24h canary. thanks all.
